capabilities: add colored highlights, notes, and ruby annotations to text without modifying source files
browse, search, and filter annotations in a card sidebar by file, color, keyword, or tag
batch delete or tag selected annotation cards
review annotations in a shuffled full-screen mode with Again/Mastered actions
import annotation data from older plugin versions
disambiguation: Not a flashcard/space-repetition plugin; its review mode simply shuffles and walks through existing annotations in a full-screen overlay.
extras: Manual installation only via GitHub Releases; annotation data is stored in separate Markdown files under the plugin directory, and embeds and code blocks cannot be annotated.
intentEvidence: extends annotation-marker's existing sidebar; UI/interaction design is inspired by HiLighter
motivation: The author fused two upstream plugins: annotation-marker's data layer and HiLighter's card-management UI concepts, rewriting the card logic in TypeScript.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to highlight and annotate text without editing the original Markdown file or aggregating annotations across the vault.

relations.evidence: UI/interaction design is inspired by HiLighter by PandoraReads

summary: Text annotation and highlight plugin that stores annotations separately from notes and manages them as filterable cards with a review mode.
